video.title: AI欧腐《四分卫室友想驯服我/My Quarterback Roommate Wants to Tame My Body》
video.desc:
Star quarterback Dylan and campus loner Roman are forced into the same dorm room — and when a chance encounter in the showers wakes a desire Dylan can't name, tutoring sessions and a season-ending injury turn rivalry into something neither will say out loud. A video that looks like hate speech drives them into silence; Dylan's father threatens Roman's future and Dylan walks away. He comes back only to tear Roman out of an underground club and a patron's hands — and then loses him again, this time because Roman leaves to protect the NFL dream Dylan can't afford to surrender. Dylan learns the truth, cuts his family loose, and earns the league on his own. On the night he wins it all, in front of the world, they kiss.
明星四分卫 Dylan 与校园独行者 Roman 被迫住进了同一间宿舍。浴室里的一次意外相遇，唤醒了 Dylan 说不出口的渴望；补课时光与一场赛季报销的重伤，让针锋相对渐渐变成了两人谁也不肯说出口的东西。
一段看似仇恨言论的视频，把两人逼进了沉默。Dylan 的父亲威胁要毁掉 Roman 的前途，Dylan 选择了离开。他再次回来，只为把 Roman 从一家地下俱乐部、从一个金主手里硬生生拽出来——然后又一次失去了他。这一次，是 Roman 主动离开，为了守护 Dylan 那个不能放弃的 NFL 梦。
Dylan 得知真相，与家族彻底决裂，凭自己的力量闯进了联盟。
在他赢下一切的那个夜晚，当着全世界的面，他们接吻了。
